# Vendored skill: do not edit

This folder is a verbatim copy of `skills/drizzle-responses-and-errors` from the npm package `drizzle-kit@1.0.0-rc.4`, taken from the registry tarball and verified against its integrity hash. The version is the one `plugins/nuvraxis-fullstack/templates/pnpm-catalog.yaml` pins for generated apps, so the skill always matches the `drizzle-kit` the app installs. Package, version and integrity are recorded in `UPSTREAM.json`.

To update: change the version in `plugins/nuvraxis-fullstack/templates/pnpm-catalog.yaml`, then run `pnpm sync` from the repository root. CI runs `pnpm sync --check` and fails if anything here differs, so local edits will not survive.

The skill may suggest running `drizzle-kit skills` to refresh: with this plugin installed, refreshing happens through the plugin's version instead.
